BC_description: The .spread() method on Promise objects no longer accepts a second argument for error handling. Previously, .spread() accepted both onFulfilled and onRejected handler arguments like Promise.all([p1,p2,p3]).spread(onFulfilled, onRejected), but now only accepts the onFulfilled handler.
Adaptation_method: Replace Promise.all([...]).spread(onFulfilled, onRejected) with Promise.all([...]).spread(onFulfilled).catch(onRejected). Note that the behavior might differ slightly since errors from the onFulfilled handler would also be caught by the catch handler.
